justification: The confirmation compares ONE fixed six-member bundle to ONE frozen anchor on future races. The retraining-noise term is transferred from the single-model fold SD 0.001816 (spec 100, k=1) without any sqrt(6) or sqrt(7) reduction: the six members share the same training population and split only by seed and by a 13-column drop, so they are not independent bundle replicates (independent_bundle_replicates=1), and study 100 measured seed correlation rho~0.234 with a k->inf floor of 48% of single-seed variance. Transferring the full single-model SD is therefore conservative for the seed component; it does not claim to bound the (untested) variance of re-assembling a bundle from fresh fits, which the estimand excludes by fixing the bundle.
